create_media_connector: create a MediaConnector instance with media_io_kwargs, allowed_local_media_path, and allowed_media_domains
merge_media_io_kwargs: merge config-level and per-request media_io_kwargs per modality with modality-specific logic
fetch_image: fetch a PIL image from an HTTP, data, or file URL with configurable image_mode
fetch_video: fetch video frames as a numpy array with metadata from an HTTP or base64 data URL
fetch_audio: fetch audio as a numpy array and sample rate from an HTTP or file URL
